integrity: The proof is self-contained once the defining shift and potential from the cited source are fixed. The lower and upper estimates are analytic and do not rely on numerical experiments.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the specific sofic shift and one-coordinate potential in Remark 9.12, not arbitrary failures of the Mañé lemma.
The exact finite-slack value of the optimal Lipschitz seminorm is not determined; the result determines its sharp logarithmic asymptotic rate.
The literature search did not reveal an equivalent quantitative statement, but terminology outside the inspected sources remains a residual overlap risk.
title: Sharp exponential cost of approximate Mañé subactions on a sofic shift
